## Gilded Sea Serpent (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
N Medium dragon (aquatic)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +11  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 14, flat-footed 26 (+4 Dex, +16 natural)  
**hp** 80 (5d12+15 plus 5)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +8, **Will** +7  
**DR** 5/gold; **Immune** paralysis and sleep, dragon traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft.; swim 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +9 (1d8+4 plus poison)  
**Special Attacks** constrict (1d8+1), poison  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 19, **Con** 16, **Int** 7, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +9 (+13 grapple); **CMD** 20 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Swim-By AttackB, Toughness, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Perception +11, Stealth +12, Survival +11, Swim +17  
**Languages** Draconic  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite–injury; *save* Fort DC 15; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Wis; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Golden Bliss (Narcotic)** This drug is made from the venom of a gilded sea serpent. A serpent that is milked of its venom produces enough poison to make 2d4 doses of golden bliss per day. This requires a DC 15 Craft (alchemy or poison) check. When inhaled, the drug produces a euphoric catatonia and provides complete protection against mind-influencing magic and psionic incursion.
